registrar_rulings.reason: Rapini (Brassica rapa) is a different plant and purchase from broccoli ($2.09/lb Aldi) and broccolini ($3.99/each Baker's); the feed has zero rabe/rapini/raab strings, and no namespace carries the word anywhere. But the live broccoli include is the bare pattern 'broccoli', which WILL claim 'Broccoli Rabe' product names, so this id may not go live bare: mint broccoli-rabe as weekly-staples (commodities.json, unit likely each/bunch) with a full ~150-pattern exclude list modeled on broccolini's, ADD excludes 'rabe|rapini|raab' to both broccoli and broccolini, and record allowlist pairs broccoli-rabe/broccoli and broccoli-rabe/broccolini (different plant, reviewed) so the daily audit never re-flags them.

Dry-cured prosciutto is a different cure and price class from deli-ham ($0.1238/oz — prosciutto typically runs 5-8x that) and the feed contains no prosciutto or parma string, so it is genuinely unpriced, not merely unmatched. The seam to close: deli-ham's include is '\bham\b', which would claim products labeled 'Parma Ham', and its exclude list has no prosciutto/parma entry — mint prosciutto in weekly staples (commodities.json + capture worklist, unit oz, deli 3-4 oz pack class) with include 'prosciutto' and 'parma\s+ham', add 'prosciutto' and 'parma' to deli-ham's excludes, and record the allowlist pair prosciutto/deli-ham (different cure, reviewed).

Same base food, different form: a reduced sweetened glaze is a different purchase from balsamic-vinegar ($0.1704/floz Fareway), and the estate already agrees — balsamic-vinegar's live exclude list contains '\bglaze\b' and 'reduction', i.e. glaze products are deliberately unclaimed today, and the feed's only priced 'glaze' is a Kikkoman soy glaze under another id. Mint balsamic-glaze (recipe-only: recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities, unit floz) with real excludes (soy glaze, teriyaki, hot honey, donut/dessert glazes, vinaigrette, dressing), FIX the recipe-commodities balsamic-vinegar include — it is the bare word 'balsamic' and would swallow glaze sale items — by adding a glaze/reduction exclude there, and record the allowlist pair balsamic-glaze/balsamic-vinegar (different form: reduction vs vinegar).

macro_cross_check: PASS. Source publishes 540 cal / 47 C / 43 P per serving at 8 servings; my lines recompute to 508 cal (-5.9%), 47.3 g carbs (+0.6%) and 40.7 g protein (-5.4%), inside the 15% protein tolerance. Protein is 279 g of the 326 g total from the 1360.8 g pork loin alone. Caveat stated loudly: this counts the whole brine (1/3 cup salt, 1/3 cup sugar) and the brine spices, which are discarded - drop the brine sugar and per-serving calories fall to about 476, which is why my figure sits under the source's. Band check at target scale: 476-508 cal is inside 450-800, but 40.7 g protein clears the 40 g floor by less than a gram, so any downward revision of the pork weight or of the prosciutto retires this recipe.
